tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included; there is no development-build exception, so certificates must be verified in every build, dev and release alike.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It has one paragraph saying TLS certificate verification stays on for all builds, development builds included, with no dev exception.

That comes from the recorded decision #29, "Withdrawing that, verification on all builds", which replaced the earlier dev-build exception (#27). The file doesn't mention that earlier exception.

I didn't use #32 ("Https everywhere, no plaintext exceptions here"). It covers plaintext HTTP, not certificate verification.

My first attempt at writing the file with a shell heredoc failed with a parser error. I wrote it with the Write tool instead. The file is untracked and I haven't committed it.
